records.description: Open this Dispatch Case to view product rows, quantities, batch/LOT, expiry, scanned qty, missing qty, FEFO warnings, and packing problems.

records.name: Item-hs_code
records.label: HS Code
records.description: Harmonized System commodity code - determines import tax category.

records.name: Item-import_tax_rate
records.label: Import Tax Rate (%)
records.description: Fixed import tax rate for this items HS code. Used to pre-fill LCV import duty.

records.name: Item Reorder-buffer_percentage
records.label: Safety Stock Buffer %
records.description: Safety stock buffer as a fraction (e.g. 0.20 = 20%). Used in norm calculation. Defaults to 20% when blank.
